description: Land Acquisition - Werahera, Katuwawala, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain described lands are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and assessment numbers, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
